objective: Build and check a rotation-system-to-knot-space builder; splice a Fano atom at lines of K_2-K_4; prove and check that the grown space is a torus whose natural law keeps the sphere's contradiction in exactly one class; prove and check that learning then resolves it by winding through the new handle; compute costs by placement and the rules R0, R3, R7 (H1-H5).
status: Proved 2026-11-10 (by hand where marked; computed parts marked; pre-registered): a Fano atom spliced at a knot sphere's line gives a torus whose old law extends with no even face uniquely up to gauge; on all 540 grown tori tested (K_2-K_5) the atom acts as the replaced line in the grown class and is transparent in the others (computed), so the grown law is the only unsatisfiable class and growth alone does not resolve; learning then resolves it, every resolution changing a sign in the grown handle (proved). Grown at the dissonance the violated line moves into the atom and learning resolves it in 3 sign changes on every sphere; farther away it costs more (computed).
title: A Fano atom grown at a knot sphere's dissonance
